en: Sepia-toned historic street view of a small European town. Timber-framed and masonry houses line a slightly curving main street leading toward low hills in the background. Several people stand and walk along the road. On the right is a prominent multi-story half-timbered building with a steep roof and small tower, likely the town hall. German text is printed at the top of the card.
